facts.fact: The World Bank aide-memoire says the PFSS-RRC project runs a management information system (MIS) in which beneficiary payment dates and beneficiary data for its cash-transfer and exit-fund activities are kept, and says the MIS is in use at the project's digitalisation department.
The World Bank aide-memoire says extension and improvement of the project MIS, with the firm ASTRUM, is 75% done, with a payment module and a tamper-proof digital card still to be improved.

The World Bank aide-memoire says the project created a mobile-money account for every social cash transfer beneficiary household and reports 39,904 beneficiaries receiving payments by mobile money (41,203 including flood-affected households).

systems.platform: MIS built and extended with the firm ASTRUM
systems.owner: UGP-FSS (Unite de Gestion des Projets Filets Sociaux)
